comment: Golden abstain set (negatives). Each query asks something the corpus genuinely CANNOT answer, because vendors do not publish that category of information on their own domain -- not because a query happened to score low in a prior run. Authored blind from a principled list of categories (unreleased roadmap, business metrics, named-customer pricing, internal security/incident detail, competitor benchmarks the vendor did not run, support-ticket internals, and cross-vendor questions asked of the wrong company's corpus) BEFORE ever calling retrieve() on them. Do not add, remove, or reword entries based on where they score -- a high-scoring negative is a genuine finding to report, not a reason to delete it. Companies restricted to Pinecone/Weaviate/MongoDB, the only three Phase 1 touches.
